title: Port Date millisecond clipping and UTC ISO timestamp formatting
scope: Own pure-Rust Date TimeClip and ISO UTC formatting over f64 milliseconds, plus lazy PageStale timestamp adapter. Preserve calendar boundaries, extended years, invalid-time errors and no sampling after first mark. OS current-time acquisition remains separate.
acceptance: Pinned original markPageStale with real Date.toISOString compares wide seeded millisecond inputs, exact timestamps, errors, clock counts and state before Rust.
Invalid and bounded-host errors stay distinct; all old clock/normalization corpora remain required.
open_items: Actual OS current-time acquisition, browser clock wiring and complete registry execution remain separate.
Source native Date semantics are captured under pinned Node22; actual Chrome-Wasm timestamp corpus execution remains required.
